newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Izetbegovic agrees to sack top offivials - U.S. envoy.
newsitem.headline: Izetbegovic agrees to sack top offivials - U.S. envoy.

text.p: Bosnia's president bowed to U.S. pressure on Friday and agreed to fire two senior defence officials, including one with strong ties to Iran, clearing the way for delivery of a massive shipment of American arms, a U.S. envoy said.

"President (Alija) Izetbegovic informed us and gave us the documents which would remove Deputy Minister Hasan Cengic and Minister Vladimir Soljic from office," U.S. special envoy James Pardew told Reuters in Sarajevo on Friday.
